# Rebuilding a message table header must restore its semantic sort state

updateColumns rebuilds the header with setColumns when order changes, then calls restoreSortIndicator before restoring widths. restoreSortIndicator derives the current primary column from the view. updateSortIndicator removes the old aria-sort and writes ascending or descending on the new header. This is now both the chevron state and the semantic state for assistive technology. Manual DOM lifecycle proposal for the thread pane: restore transient state after replacing its owner nodes, and read that state from the view model. Do not assume that matching column data or old header state survives a rebuild. The null gDBView guard and absence of the selected header are valid no-op cases. No live screen-reader output or sorting UI test was executed.

Scope: thread-pane-sort.
